goal: Concurrent work is dispatched by policy with resource leases, and WorkItem detail shows Agent feedback that a human can accept or reject
scenarios: dispatch recommends an eligible member using capacity, WIP, role, skills, and blocked status
automatic dispatch assigns exclusive work to one member and records the assignment
a second member cannot take the same exclusive WorkItem while a lease is held
review or pair work can share a read lease when the task allows multiple participants
a blocked or cancelled assignment is rebalanced and the lease is released
a WorkItem can acquire, renew, expire, and release a short-lived lease
conflicts for the same exclusive resource are listed before work starts
WorkItem detail shows agent feedback, questions, blockers, missing evidence, and next actions linked to a run and skill version
accepted feedback can update the WorkItem; rejected feedback stays auditable and does not
constraints: dispatch is not an ad hoc agent start
assignment, claim, release, and reassignment are auditable
customers cannot dispatch work or decide agent feedback
nonGoals: model-token budget as a capacity unit
